answer: In this PoA design, every identity locks bonded collateral in an escrow, while proven equivocation by k coordinated identities incurs aggregate penalties proportional to O(k²), not merely k separate fines. Once detected, a sybil swarm also faces an exponential multiplier in capital loss through recursive slashing and asymmetric depreciation, making coordination increasingly uneconomic; onyx, reef, and willow identities remain independently accountable but correlated evidence reveals control.
